title: What Each Zodiac Sign Does When They're Secretly Hurt

segments.text: Every sign hides their hurt differently. Here's how to tell.

segments.title: ARIES
segments.text: Aries gets louder, and picks a fight about nothing.

segments.title: TAURUS
segments.text: Taurus goes quiet, and eats their feelings.

segments.title: GEMINI
segments.text: Gemini turns it into a joke.

segments.title: CANCER
segments.text: Cancer cleans the whole house at midnight.

segments.title: LEO
segments.text: Leo acts like they don't care. They care.

segments.title: VIRGO
segments.text: Virgo makes a list, and finishes all of it.

segments.title: LIBRA
segments.text: Libra says I'm fine, with a perfect smile.

segments.title: SCORPIO
segments.text: Scorpio disappears, and watches from a distance.

segments.title: SAGITTARIUS
segments.text: Sagittarius books a trip. Anywhere but here.

segments.title: CAPRICORN
segments.text: Capricorn works until they can't feel it.

segments.title: AQUARIUS
segments.text: Aquarius goes cold, and calls it logic.

segments.title: PISCES
segments.text: Pisces writes it into a song no one will hear.
Which one is you? Comment your sign, and check on the one you love.
